Weekend Club Rides

Redding, CA · Road

Weekend Club Rides is a road group ride in Redding, CA. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 8:30 am from Varies by ride: Sundial Bridge parking lot, CVS at 3375 Placer St, Anderson Starbucks, Palo Cedro park and ride.

For visitors

Open the dated entry on the club calendar for the start, distance and pace. Non-members bring a signed waiver. Start times shift earlier in summer heat.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: posted on each ride (C/D on the Oct 4 ride). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Weekend Club Rides group ride

The club's numbered weekend rides, 30 to 70 miles, each with its own route, start and pace rating. Each is its own dated entry on the club Google Calendar. Oct 3 starts at Anderson Starbucks and Oct 4 at the Placer St CVS.
